summary: The fund is an exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to meet its objective by having Corgi Strategies, LLC (the "adviser") actively manage the fund and, under ordinary market conditions, invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in a portfolio of companies materially involved in the design, manufacturing, integration, deployment, and operation of battery energy storage systems used to support electric grids, renewable integration, peak demand management, backup power, and electrification across residential, commercial, and utility scale applications. It is non-diversified.
